## Literature

The course is primarily based on the text book:

* Farrell, S., & Lewandowsky, S. (2018). *Computational modeling of cognition and behavior.* Cambridge University Press. [eBook](https://eur.on.worldcat.org/oclc/1028902356)

Note: Book chapters and articles are only accessible from the university campus. To access these materials from home, you need to set up a
[VPN connection (on-campus simulation)](https://www.eur.nl/en/library/using-library/access-online-collection).

## R Introduction

This [R mini tutorial](r_basics/index.html) is a short introduction to the programming language R. It is designed for students of the course *Data Science* and provides a basic understanding of R programming.
